love.title: The evening I stopped waiting
lines: Warm sunlight fills the room, and I feel completely at home.
I set the table for two without rehearsing what I will say.
Their laugh lands softly, and the future stops feeling far away.
I stay. That is the whole story, and it is enough.

money.title: A morning with the numbers settled
lines: The numbers settle, and I choose my morning without rushing.
Coffee cools while I decide what the day is actually for.
I pay the bill that used to sit in the back of my mind.
Freedom, it turns out, sounds a lot like a quiet kitchen.

family.title: The kitchen that already knows us
lines: Laughter reaches the kitchen before I do, and I already belong.
Someone saved me a chair without making a speech about it.
The window is open, and the evening has nowhere else to be.
I listen longer than I talk, and that feels like love.

career.title: The room I walked into ready
lines: I walk into the room already certain of the work I came to do.
My name is on the work, and I do not shrink it to fit.
The question they ask is one I have already lived inside.
I leave with the next chapter still open, on purpose.

health.title: A body I trust again
lines: My breath is slow, and my body feels like a place I trust.
I take the long way home because my legs want the light.
Rest is on the calendar, the same way work used to be.
I thank the day for being ordinary and kind.

legal.draft: This is placeholder legal copy for the marketing site. Have counsel review it before you publish.

termsSections.title: The agreement
termsSections.body: These terms are a draft. They will govern your use of the LUMORA Manifest app and this website once a lawyer has reviewed them. By downloading LUMORA Manifest you will agree to the published terms.

termsSections.title: The service
termsSections.body: LUMORA Manifest writes personalized audio stories from the details you choose to share, and can narrate them in a voice you record or in a preset voice. Stories are generated for you. They are not a promise that a future event will happen.

termsSections.title: Accounts and subscriptions
termsSections.body: LUMORA Manifest offers Explore, LUMORA Manifest Plus, and LUMORA Manifest Premium. Subscriptions are managed through the App Store, including restore purchases. They auto-renew until you cancel in the App Store. Prices on this website come from config/site.ts.

termsSections.title: Your stories and voice
termsSections.body: You keep the right to the personal details you submit. You grant LUMORA Manifest permission to use a voice recording only after you consent, and only to narrate your stories. You can delete recordings and your account.

termsSections.title: Acceptable use
termsSections.body: Do not use LUMORA Manifest to impersonate someone else, to record a voice you do not have permission to use, or to break the law. We may suspend an account that misuses voice cloning.

termsSections.title: Contact
termsSections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to support@lumoramanifest.com or from the support page. This draft does not limit rights you have under the laws of your country.

privacySections.title: What you share
privacySections.body: Onboarding asks about your world, your goals, and the life you want to hear. You share only what you are comfortable with. You can skip details and still use LUMORA Manifest.

privacySections.title: Voice clone and consent
privacySections.body: A voice clone is created only after you agree. LUMORA Manifest uses that clone to narrate your stories. You can keep up to three recordings, switch to a preset voice (Emma, Lauren, Henry, or James), or delete a recording.

privacySections.title: Microphone
privacySections.body: The microphone is used only while you are recording a voice sample. LUMORA Manifest does not keep the microphone open in the background.

privacySections.title: Deleting your account
privacySections.body: You can delete your account at any time from the app. Deletion removes your profile, stories tied to the account, and voice recordings, subject to copies we must keep to meet the law.

privacySections.title: Contact
privacySections.body: Privacy questions can be sent to support@lumoramanifest.com or through the support page. This policy is a placeholder and should be replaced before launch.
